method: monodromy spectral projector P_mu=(M-I)^3/(mu-1)^3 around z=1/3; A_Phi s_vec = (M-I)^3 phi_vec/(mu-1)^3; only Phi continued (3 loops)

witnesses.accuracy_witness_note: deformation invariance (base/radius/step) + 4-component consistency are the witnesses; no structural/det quantity used (cc3-2s2-2a lesson). dps set before any mpf (dps-ordering control).

period_matrix.object: rank-2 H2 connection; period realised on convergent Borel-2 transform Phi (order-4 L)
period_matrix.de_Rham_basis: { [Phi], [theta.Phi] } (Hien Sec.3); equivalently the two formal solutions e^{-a/sqrt t}(...) at t=0, a=2/sqrt3
period_matrix.rapid_decay_cycles: { gamma_+ : Borel-Laplace ray arg t=0^+ (the singular ray carrying z=1/3), gamma_- : the off-singular dual ray } (Hien Sec.2, H1^rd dim 2)
period_matrix.monodromy_period_point: the dim-2 D8 character variety point (tr M0, kappa) is now FULLY computed: tr M0 = -51.0655...(2a, b1fea3ed) is the diagonal/trace invariant; kappa is the single nontrivial off-diagonal Stokes/connection entry, computed here as the connection coefficient A_Phi to 129 digits.
period_matrix.stokes_matrix_structure: slope-1/2 ramified ==> a single active Stokes ray at z=1/3; the 2x2 connection matrix is [[1, kappa],[0,1]] up to the formal-monodromy diagonal (exchange of the two e^{+-a/sqrt t} sheets, elementary). The ONLY transcendental entry is kappa.
period_matrix.note: A_Phi = coefficient of the (1-3z)^{-4/3} Frobenius solution at z=1/3 in the z=0-analytic solution Phi; an EXPONENTIAL period of the globally irregular L (z=infinity slope 1/4).  By the transfer theorem A_Phi = Gamma(4/3)*A0_resurgence and the cc3-2s2-1 bridge kappa = Gamma(4/3)*A0, so the connection coefficient A_Phi IS the Stokes constant kappa directly (off-diagonal period entry).
